site.name: 360atlas
site.description: The world map where VR photographers and 360° creators list their virtual tours and get found by travellers, venues and businesses.

home.heroText: Share your 360 work and discover others'.
home.categoriesHint: Scroll to spin through every category
home.ctaText: Start free with 5 listings. Upgrade for enquiries, analytics and featured placement.
home.how1Text: Add your business, the platforms you work with and the areas you cover.
home.how2Text: Paste a link from Matterport, Kuula, 3DVista or any platform. Each tour gets its own pin on the map.
home.how3Text: People find your work on the map, open your tours and contact you directly.

categoriesPage.title: Categories
categoriesPage.intro: Browse virtual tours by the kind of place.
categoriesPage.empty: No tours in this category yet.

mapPage.title: Map
mapPage.intro: Every pin is a place you can step inside.

providersPage.title: Service providers
providersPage.intro: Find a VR photographer or virtual tour agency near you.
providersPage.empty: No providers match that location yet.

membership.title: Membership
membership.intro: Free to start. Upgrade when you want leads, analytics and featured placement.
membership.freeDesc: Fill the map with your work.
membership.businessDesc: Be seen first, everywhere you work.
membership.lapseText: Your listings stay live. Paid perks switch off until you resubscribe.

about.title: About 360atlas
about.p1: 360atlas is one map for virtual tours from every platform: Matterport, Kuula, 3DVista, CloudPano, Google Street View and more.
about.p2: Travellers use it to see a place before they go. VR photographers and tour owners use it to be found.
about.p3: Tours always open on the platform that hosts them, with full credit to the people who made them.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Questions, partnerships or a tour you want removed? Write to us.
contact.name: Your name
contact.soon: The contact form goes live at launch.
